title: Net link
summary: A message transport contract shaped like ISteamNetworkingSockets (peers, lanes, reliable and unreliable sends, close reasons, stats), a seeded in-process network simulator for tests and a packet capture that works on any transport.
provides: net_link_send / net_link_poll / net_link_flush / net_link_close / net_link_destroy: the calls every transport answers
net_link_init + net_link_ops_t: the table a transport fills
net_link_sim_create / net_link_sim_host / net_link_sim_guest / net_link_sim_advance / net_link_sim_set_conditions / net_link_sim_set_cut: the seeded in-process network
net_link_capture_open / net_link_capture_attach / net_link_capture_set_time / net_link_capture_reader_*: the capture file and its reader
